endomorphism.frobenius_order_rule: Z[pi], pi = tau^n, has discriminant t^2 - 4q = -7 f^2
endomorphism.proof: tau(x, y) = (x^2, y^2) is an F_2-rational endomorphism with tau^2 - mu tau + 2 = 0; Z[tau] has discriminant mu^2 - 8 = -7, a fundamental discriminant, so Z[tau] is the maximal order of Q(sqrt(-7)), and End(E/F_2^n) is an order of that field containing it

volcano_levels.odd_ell: L0 (surface) for every odd prime ell: v_ell(1) = 0

field.element_encoding: unsigned integer; bit i is the coefficient of z^i

point_decomposition.cache_policy: target-independent descent pieces cached per factor base
point_decomposition.completion_test: refutation (1 in the row space) needs no oracle; for S >= 1 solutions the scan stops when the standard monomials number S, with S and the solutions read off an exhaustive enumeration (Moebius transform) that is charged to the phase it serves
point_decomposition.equation_order: equation t is bit t of each F_2^n coefficient, t = 0..n-1
point_decomposition.internal_kernel: pdpkernel.c incremental echelon with highest-bit pivots
point_decomposition.solver: incremental dense Macaulay degree scan over F_2[x]/(x_i^2 + x_i); stop at refutation (1 in row space) or Groebner completion (standard monomials = #solutions)
point_decomposition.summation_polynomials: curve-independent symbolic S_k from pdp-scaling/sumpoly.py, loaded once per process before the run (not charged)
point_decomposition.weil_descent: x_i = sum_j v_ij beta_j over the factor-base basis; v^2 = v

relation_collection.dependencies: rows reduced into an incremental echelon form mod r; only rank-increasing rows kept
relation_collection.query_law: the workload's ordinary subgroup points R = [k]G, one PDP attempt each
relation_collection.rows: every verified decomposition (proper or improper, every sign choice) of R, as a row over the folded columns with right-hand side k
relation_collection.stop: rank reaches the achievable rank (m = 2: rank of the two-point relations of every subgroup target, computed in precompute) or the effective column count (m >= 3)
relation_collection.verification: relations.classify_solution: lift each abscissa and check the signed point sum is R

relation_linear_algebra.solver: incremental dense Gaussian elimination mod r (monitor.RankTracker), back substitution with free columns set to 0

target_descent.policy: Q + [a]G with a from the workload's rerandomization stream, decomposed by the same PDP solver until a verified relation appears; log Q = sum c_j log_j - a mod r
